name: Kesar
traditionalUses: Skin glow (in milk or face packs)
kitchenUse: A few strands soaked in warm milk, then stirred into kheer, biryani or kesar doodh.

typicalUse.adultAmount: A few strands (well under 100 mg) a day
typicalUse.note: Saffron is often adulterated; buy from a trusted source.

cautions.note: Food amounts are fine, but larger amounts can stimulate the uterus and should be avoided in pregnancy.

interactions.effect: Medicinal amounts may lower blood pressure further.
Studied for low mood; do not combine medicinal amounts with antidepressants without your doctor.

evidence.summary: Several small trials suggest saffron extracts may help mild to moderate low mood, but most were short and small.
